title: 第1608章 攻守易型第1607章 空间魔器
content_zh:
因为空间扰乱魔器的影响，默里·格林的瞬移被打断，加上拜伦·廉德的不断干扰。
两人距离已经被拉近到了万米，有人皆不由得屏息凝神的看着战场，有人却惊呼连连起来。
“拜伦岛主近身了，默里·格林完蛋了。”
只见拜伦·廉德马上朝着默里·格林挥出手中长剑，一道黑暗剑芒瞬息杀至对方身前，而默里·格林身前突然就凝结出大量六边形空间屏障。
黑暗剑芒劈砍到空间屏障上，爆发出汹涌的对碰余波，拜伦·廉德毫不犹豫的冲进余波之中。
不过下一瞬，对碰余波在空中变缓，犹如一朵正在绽放的花朵，看起来格外壮观。
感受到拜伦·廉德准备冲脸的默里·格林，立即将身前空间凝滞住。
感受到身边空间好像伸出许多只手，死死抓住他身体拜伦·廉德，马上又从空间戒指中取出一张空间树叶。
他直接将空间树叶塞入口中，快速咀嚼起来，迅速从其中压榨出空间力量。
获得空间力量的拜伦·廉德将这股空间力量加持在自己的右臂上，让其不受空间凝滞的束缚，然后全力挥出手中长剑。
“黑暗斩。”
在黑暗斩之下，本就摇摇欲坠的空间屏障应声破裂，残余的攻击继续杀向了默里·格林，但却被一道次元裂锋从中间劈开，没有对其造成半点伤害。
不过拜伦·廉德却趁机离默里·格林越来越近了，可就在这时，一个灰色圆球从默里·格林身体中展开。
“空间领域，展开。”
空间领域的边缘是坚固的空间屏障，所以当空间领域展开时，这空间屏障就像是一堵墙似的，朝着冲来的拜伦·廉德撞了过去。
“封光刺，开。”
看着又一道空间屏障出现，拜伦·廉德手中长剑变得犹如黑洞一般，将周围的光芒全部吸收，一切化作黑暗，随后化作一柄黑暗长剑，刺在了空间领域的屏障上。
拜伦·廉德的实力比默里·格林更强，加上单点刺击下，他成功的在空间领域的屏障上刺出了一条裂痕。
紧接着，所有黑暗就沿着这条裂痕透进了默里·格林的空间领域，在这个过程中，裂痕越来越大，被拜伦·廉德强行破开了一个大洞，击破了默里·格林的空间领域。
魔法师的领域功能各异，但无论是什么领域，在战斗时，都尽量不要在其完整的领域中战斗，不然会受到很大限制。

所以拜伦·廉德在击碎空间领域的屏障后，没有再继续朝着默里·格林靠近过去，而是让自己的黑暗力量依附在其屏障上，对其进行侵蚀，再次削弱魔法领域的效果。
但默里·格林可不会眼睁睁的看着拜伦·廉德继续破坏自己的空间领域，他迅速调动空间领域的所有魔法粒子，将其制作成魔法导弹。
“啪嗒~”
由于此地在海上，所以第一枚水属性导弹快速成型，在默里·格林的一个响指下，朝着拜伦·廉德所在位置飞出。
content_en:
Due to the influence of the space disrupting magic weapon, Murray Green's teleportation was interrupted, coupled with Byron Liande's constant interference.
The distance between the two has been shortened to 10,000 meters. Some people couldn't help but hold their breath and look at the battlefield, while others exclaimed in surprise.
"Lord Byron is close, Murray Green is finished."
I saw Byron Lian De immediately swinging his long sword towards Murray Green, and a dark sword light instantly struck in front of the opponent, and a large number of hexagonal space barriers suddenly condensed in front of Murray Green.
The dark sword light struck the space barrier, erupting into a turbulent aftermath, and Byron Liande rushed into the aftermath without hesitation.
But the next moment, the aftermath of the collision slowed down in the air, like a blooming flower, which looked particularly spectacular.
Murray Green, who felt that Byron Lian was about to get in his face, immediately froze the space in front of him.
Feeling that the space around him seemed to stretch out many hands, Byron Liande grabbed his body tightly, and immediately took out another space leaf from the space ring.
He directly stuffed the space leaves into his mouth, chewed them quickly, and quickly squeezed out the space power from them.
Byron Liande, who had obtained the power of space, applied this space power to his right arm so that it would not be bound by the stagnation of space, and then swung the sword in his hand with all his strength.
"Dark Slash."
Under the Dark Slash, the already shaky space barrier burst apart, and the remaining attacks continued to attack Murray Green, but were split in the middle by a dimensional crack, without causing any damage to him.
However, Byron Liande took the opportunity to get closer and closer to Murray Green, but at this moment, a gray ball unfolded from Murray Green's body.
"Space realm, expand."
The edge of the space domain is a solid space barrier, so when the space domain unfolds, the space barrier is like a wall, hitting the charging Byron Liande.
"Sealing Light Thorn, open."
Seeing another space barrier appear, the long sword in Byron Liande's hand became like a black hole, absorbing all the surrounding light, turning everything into darkness, and then turned into a dark sword, piercing the barrier of the space domain.
Byron Lian De was stronger than Murray Green, and with a single stab, he successfully stabbed a crack in the barrier of the space field.
Immediately afterwards, all the darkness penetrated into Murray Green's space realm along this crack. In the process, the crack became bigger and bigger, and a big hole was forcibly opened by Byron Liande, breaking Murray Green's space realm.
The magician's domain has different functions, but no matter what domain it is, when fighting, try not to fight in its complete domain, otherwise it will be greatly restricted.
Therefore, after Byron Lian De shattered the barrier of the space field, he did not continue to approach Murray Green. Instead, he allowed his dark power to attach to the barrier, erode it, and once again weakened the effect of the magic field.
But Murray Green would not just watch Byron Lian De continue to destroy his space domain. He quickly mobilized all the magic particles in the space domain and made them into magic missiles.
"Pap~"
Since this place is at sea, the first water-based missile took shape quickly and flew towards Byron Liande's location with a snap of Murray Green's fingers.
